A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 649.5 million dollars, Crypto.com sent out 28.6 million dollars, and KuCoin sent out 18.6 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 14.5 million dollars.
